meta.source: UN DESA Population Division, World Population Prospects 2024
meta.revisionPolicy: Each WPP revision re-estimates the whole history from 1950 and re-projects to 2100. A new revision is a new instrument; the raw dump keeps the old one.
meta.coverage: UN WPP 2024 population of India by five-year age group and sex, 1 July, 1950 to 2023, with broad-age shares and dependency ratios
meta.note: Estimates, thousands of people. Broad-age shares and dependency ratios are derived here from the age groups and labelled so.

age_100_total.label: Population aged 100 and over, both sexes, thousands

age_100_female.label: Population aged 100 and over, females, thousands
